historical_record.description: Recorded in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor as built for use as a tire and battery shop. Built for Kahn and Keville, who have sold Goodyear tires here — and at times batteries, radios and household appliances — since it was put up. Its wings embrace an outdoor space where cars could park and manoeuvre.
Evaluated in the city's survey of the Van Ness Avenue automobile corridor and given California Register status code 3CS — individually eligible for the California Register, under Criteria 1 and 3.
